cohort: 22 women who underwent caesarean section due to placenta percreta and 22 women who underwent caesarean section for other obstetric reasons
finding: Women with placenta percreta had lower preoperative circulating levels of vascular endothelial growth factor, placental growth factor and soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase 1 compared to controls, while postoperative levels of vascular endothelial growth factor and soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase 1 were higher in the placenta percreta group.
